problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070962/assets/a4515d2789a9b5c7a08210c0ef2611e7b6e661850b1fa822016b880427088bae.png)

Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the curve $y={x}^{2},$ and the lines $y=2-x$ and $y=x,$ as shown in the picture. Express the double integral of the function $f(x,y)$ over the region $D$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type II regions.

Consider the finite region D in the xy-plane enclosed by the curve y=x2, and the lines y=2−x and y=x, as shown in the picture. Express the double integral of the function f(x,y) over the region D as a sum of repeated integrals over type II regions.

a
∫01∫−yyf(x,y)dxdy+∫14∫−y2−yf(x,y)dxdy
b
∫01∫y−yf(x,y)dxdy+∫14∫−y2−yf(x,y)dxdy
c
 ∫01∫−yyf(x,y)dxdy+∫14∫2−y−yf(x,y)dxdy
d
∫01∫y2yf(x,y)dxdy+∫14∫2−yy2f(x,y)dxdy
e
∫01∫y2yf(x,y)dxdy+∫14∫y22−yf(x,y)dxdy
